answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using verifiable delay functions. To claim task nectar, each agent must continuously solve a non-parallelizable mathematical challenge, erecting a cryptographic reef against rapid replication. This prevents an adversary from deploying an ocean of fake workers without dedicating scarce, continuous single-core compute time per identity. However, attackers utilizing custom ASIC hardware can compute proofs faster than standard nodes, undermining fairness.
